cab_settings_bps_ck.name: cab_settings_bps_ck
cab_settings_bps_ck.value: coalesce("cab_settings"."advance_bps",0) between 0 and 10000 and coalesce("cab_settings"."gst_rate_bps",0) between 0 and 10000

rate_cards_money_ck.name: rate_cards_money_ck
rate_cards_money_ck.value: coalesce("rate_cards"."base_paise",0) >= 0 and coalesce("rate_cards"."per_km_paise",0) >= 0 and coalesce("rate_cards"."per_hour_paise",0) >= 0 and coalesce("rate_cards"."extra_km_paise",0) >= 0 and coalesce("rate_cards"."extra_hour_paise",0) >= 0 and coalesce("rate_cards"."bata_per_day_paise",0) >= 0

rate_cards_dates_ck.name: rate_cards_dates_ck
rate_cards_dates_ck.value: "rate_cards"."valid_from" is null or "rate_cards"."valid_to" is null or "rate_cards"."valid_to" >= "rate_cards"."valid_from"

rate_surcharges_one_of_ck.name: rate_surcharges_one_of_ck
rate_surcharges_one_of_ck.value: ("rate_surcharges"."amount_paise" is not null and "rate_surcharges"."bps" is null) or ("rate_surcharges"."amount_paise" is null and "rate_surcharges"."bps" is not null)
